Bolum version 1: a compact Rust desktop dictation app with local NVIDIA Canary and Parakeet speech recognition and a purple settings interface.

## Downloads

- **macOS Apple Silicon:** `Bolum-1.0.1-macos-arm64.pkg`. Run the installer, then open Bolum from Applications. Requires macOS 13.4 or later; tested locally on a newer Apple Silicon Mac.
- **Windows x64:** `Bolum-1.0.1-windows-x64-setup.exe`. Run setup and open Bolum from the Start menu. Installs for the current user and includes an uninstaller; no Python environment is required.
- Portable ZIPs are also included. `SHA256SUMS.txt` contains checksums for all downloads. Speech models are separate downloads inside the app.

Documentation: https://shivrajcode.github.io/Bolum/

GitHub Packages: https://github.com/shivrajcode/Bolum/pkgs/container/bolum-installers

Every passing push to main refreshes the Latest main build installers. Numbered releases remain unchanged.

## What's included

- Native Rust UI with General, History, Models, Advanced and About pages; purple light, dark and system themes.
- Control–Option–Space on Mac / Control–Alt–Space on Windows. Toggle, hold and automatic shortcut modes, with Escape to cancel.
- Canary 180M Flash and Parakeet v2/v3, verified and resumable model downloads, microphone choice and optional recording overlay.
- Model loading starts while recording, reducing the wait after Stop. One engine is cached until the configured idle timeout.
- Clipboard paste, direct typing and preview-only output. macOS retains the original target when the overlay takes focus, and shows a recovery message if insertion is blocked.
- Session-only history, optional audio feedback, word corrections and quiet-edge trimming.

## Setup and verification limits

On macOS, enable **Microphone** and **Accessibility** for the installed Bolum.app. Automatic pasting needs Accessibility permission; until granted, the transcript is copied for manual pasting. A locally rebuilt app may need its stale Accessibility entry removed and the current app added again.

The app is ad-hoc signed, not Apple-notarized. Windows builds are not publisher-signed. Follow the operating system's unknown-publisher flow only for a download you trust. No system security settings are disabled by the application.

Local unit/UI checks and the real Canary/Parakeet speech fixture pass. The main-only CI/CD pipeline runs checks and real speech inference on both platforms, installs the macOS PKG, and installs, starts and uninstalls the Windows package on CI runners. Successful cross-app pasting on the current Mac build remains unverified because the permission reauthorization was deferred. Windows microphone capture and cross-app insertion require testing on a real desktop; a CI build is not a substitute for that.

This release does not include Whisper, cloud cleanup, a browser runtime, an Intel Mac binary or a Windows ARM binary. Recordings are not saved, and history clears on exit.

The older `v1.0.0` source tag is preserved. This `v1.0.1` release contains the Rust desktop rebuild and current fixes.
